data.narrative:
Singularity, a Series A defense and security company that has raised $82M to date, is valued at $400M post-money. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Stark Defence, Castelion, and NODA AI.

Two valuation methods triangulate on the company's fair value. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $400M last post-money valuation, implies $800M. Peer-median methodology anchors to three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, and NODA AI at $125M), yielding a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $680M to $1.1B, with a median of $900M. This suggests the current $400M post-money valuation sits materially below the implied midpoint, though within the lower quartile of the peer set. Key uncertainties center on peer comparability given the wide dispersion in the comp sample (32x range from NODA AI to Stark Defence) and the relative stage and commercial maturity of each reference company. Revenue scale, customer concentration, and the addressable market within defense and security remain critical refinement variables.
